fields.summary_ko.0: Alphabet (GOOGL) share price plummeted 12.6% following Q3 earnings announcement, resulting in approximately $50 billion market cap loss, with current P/E ratio at its lowest level since 2012.
fields.summary_ko.1: Google Search revenue came in at $6.34 billion, missing the $6.49 billion expectation, and free cash flow of -$9.1 billion fell significantly short of the -$3.5 billion projection, with 13 analysts cutting target prices.
